summary.name: hotheadhacker/awesome-selfhost-docker
summary.one_liner: A Trendshift page showing star, fork and merged-PR activity for the GitHub repository hotheadhacker/awesome-selfhost-docker, a curated list of self-hosted Docker projects.
use_cases: Tracking star and fork growth of an open-source repo
Finding self-hosted Docker projects to run at home
Checking whether a GitHub repo is trending
Comparing activity of similar awesome lists
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Trendshift stats view for the GitHub repository hotheadhacker/awesome-selfhost-docker, which is listed under the 'Awesome Self-Host Docker' name. It shows daily stars gained, forks gained, and merged pull requests for the period Aug 30 to Oct 29, 2026. Totals for that period are +66 stars, +22 forks and 16 merged PRs over 61 days. The repository was not in the Trendshift top 25 during this period. The page also links to Trendshift trending rank, Reddit and Hacker News discussions, and similar repos, though these are not shown in the text.
notable: Daily star, fork and merged PR breakdown over 61 days
Not in the Trendshift top 25 for this period
Only one merged PR day recorded: 16 PRs on Oct 12, 2026
caveats: The page is a stats view and does not describe the repository's list contents
Covers only the Aug 30 to Oct 29, 2026 window
